description:
What if Unity Hub and GitHub Desktop had a Baby but its Adopted? Yeah..


What's new in v1.4.2
🚀 New
- Resizing to Git Sidebar
- A setting to change titlebar buttons back to mac os style if wanted
🐛 Fixes
- Repeated terminal launches when reopening GodotHub with Godot running; PR by hanmi255
✨ Improvements
- Ability to reset default width of sidebar by Double Clicking on the Resize Knob
- Changed Titlebar buttons to be more like Windows/Linux OS's
